The original live band karaoke experience in the South

How it works

1

Scan the code

  • Guests scan a QR code with their phones, no app needed
  • The QR code sits on 4x6 tabletop cards, which we can brand with your company logo
  • It can also be displayed on the venue's TVs and screens, so it's easy to spot from anywhere in the room
Try it now: scan or tap
2

Pick a song & sign up

  • Browse 1,300+ songs across every genre and decade
  • Sign up instantly and the host calls you up
→
3

Take the stage

  • Lyrics show on a screen at the front of the stage
  • Up to 4 wireless mics, so friends can sing together

    FAQs

    Quick questions

    Does it have to be karaoke the whole time?

    Not at all. The band can perform an hour or more set of songs, mix in their own performances throughout karaoke, or run only karaoke. The night is totally customizable.

    Can we pick songs that aren't on the song list?

    The band does the best with the songs they've rehearsed, so "off-list" picks are a no-go. BUT here's the fix: add our Karaoke DJ! While the band takes a break, the DJ keeps the mic hot with any song your guests can think of. That's NON-STOP karaoke all night long!

    Can we have a singing contest?

    YES! The night is up to you. We've had clients run group contests and solo contests, and some have even had their guests DRESS THE PART! WE LOVE A THEME NIGHT!
